quotes.text: The afterparty at Cannes that year — Christ. I woke up in a suite that wasn't mine, wearing a tuxedo jacket that wasn't mine either, holding a Palme d'Or that was absolutely not mine, and a note that just said 'We're even.' Best morning of my life. I still don't know whose jacket it was.
